text: Entry Requirements 1. High school diploma, good health. 2. Applicants under 18 need to submit notarized guardianship certificate upon the approval of UIBE. 3. A copy of TOEFL, or IELTS, or GRE, or Cambridge International AS, A Level, IGCSE, or IB scores report, or equivalent. The minimum score for TOEFL is 86 and 6.0 for IELTS, or BBC level or above for A Level, satisfactory GRE scores, Duolingo 120 or equivalent, (If high school courses are taught in English, please provide official certificate that the teaching language was fully in English).
